answer: Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 39 POA until the newcomer survives 10 clean epochs, and a farm of 460 fakes must find 460 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. What carries the horizon here is verification, the ridge of cost is what stops the farm, and the whisper of the record keeps every claim checkable.
